create_deprecated_class: create a class decorated with @deprecated to emit a FutureWarning on instantiation
create_deprecated_method: create a method decorated with @deprecated to emit a FutureWarning when called
create_deprecated_function: create a function decorated with @deprecated to emit a FutureWarning when invoked
test_deprecated_warnings: test that deprecated classes, methods, and functions emit FutureWarning with the correct message
test_is_deprecated: test the _is_deprecated helper to identify functions and methods wrapped by the deprecated decorator
